Promotion cannot proceed until stock synchronization is modified to apply incremental deltas.

issue_1_purchase_details.discrepancy_explanation: The plan's naive formula (11,913 - 11,892 = 21) failed to recognize that pre-refresh staging contained 1 native purchase detail item (ID 11892, invoice 2026-2027-Credit-0251, item 944, batch CGT26065C). Only 11,891 legacy rows were present before refresh. Exactly 22 incoming detail rows (Detail IDs 12323-12344 across Header IDs 5718-5726) existed in the dump. 11,891 legacy + 22 incoming = 11,913 legacy rows (100% of source dump). Together with 1 native row, staging has 11,914 total rows. No duplicates or incorrect records were inserted.

issue_2_sales_details.discrepancy_explanation: The plan anticipated 471 additions via naive subtraction (234,066 - 233,595 = 471). However, the source dump has exactly 468 detail rows for the 130 new invoices (Detail IDs 237055-237522). Pre-refresh staging had 233,595 rows because: (1) Legacy sales invoice 72160 (Bill 2026-2027-1857) was deleted in the live app, removing its 4 legacy detail rows (IDs 237051-237054); (2) Native invoice 72048 added 1 native detail row. Thus 233,598 - 4 + 1 = 233,595. Naive subtraction 234,066 - 233,595 = 471 overlooked both adjustments. The 3-record difference is precisely 4 (deleted legacy rows) - 1 (native row) = 3. All 468 incoming records were cleanly inserted.

sales_invoice_reconciliation.preservation_notes: Native invoice 72048 retains invoice_no '2026-2027-1910'. Incoming source invoice 72219 (legacy BillNo 1910) was assigned invoice_no '2026-2027-1910#72219' (target ID 72055), preserving both records without data loss.

issue_3_ledger_transactions.discrepancy_explanation: The plan guessed 44 purchase rows (22 items * 2) and 10 credit note rows (5 credit notes * 2). In reality, legacy purchase ledger entries are recorded per voucher header (9 vouchers * 2 = 18 rows). Incoming credit notes 1350-1354 had AddedToLedger = 'N' and 0 rows in creditnotevhdetail (only 21 of 1,354 credit notes in the dump ever posted to ledger). Sales ledger had 130 vouchers * 2 = 260 rows. Total incoming ledger rows in dump was exactly 278, and all 278 were inserted.

purchase_ledger_rows.reason_for_variance_from_plan: Plan anticipated 44 by assuming 2 entries per item line (22 * 2 = 44). Legacy PharmaWinner records ledger entries per voucher header (9 vouchers * 2 = 18 entries: 1 DR Purchase, 1 CR Supplier).

credit_note_ledger_rows.reason_for_variance_from_plan: Plan anticipated 10 by assuming 2 entries per credit note (5 * 2 = 10). However, all 5 incoming credit notes (1350-1354) have AddedToLedger = 'N' and 0 detail rows in creditnotevhdetail. In legacy PharmaWinner, only 21 of 1,354 credit notes were ever posted to ledger.

sales_ledger_rows.reason_for_variance_from_plan: Matches plan exactly (130 vouchers * 2 = 260 entries: 1 DR Customer/Cash, 1 CR Sales).

critical_stock_defect.root_cause: tools/legacy_refresh_engine.py Step 5 unconditionally executed: UPDATE stock_batches SET stock_qty = ? WHERE id = ? using net_loose from source stockbalance.CBqty.

issue_5_stock_and_party_reconciliation.stock_adjustments_analysis: Source dump contains stock adjustments in stockadjustmentvh/stockadjustmentvhdetail that are already baked into stockbalance.CBqty. Refreshing stock by blind overwrite wipes out native adjustments. An incremental delta engine is required.
